{'text': '《Ted Lasso》第四季於本月初播完，但劇集未來去向至今仍未有官方消息。不過，Jason Sudeikis近日在一個podcast節目中，分享了《Ted Lasso》第五季及其後續發展的最新消息。', 'paragraph_context': 'Ted Lasso season 4 wrapped up earlier this month, and there’s still no official word on the show’s future. But on a recent podcast appearance, Jason Sudeikis shared a new update on Ted Lasso season 5 and beyond.'}

{'text': '以下是《Ted Lasso》第五季及其後續發展的最新情況：', 'paragraph_context': 'Here’s the current status of Ted Lasso season 5 and beyond'}

{'text': '在Sam Frogoso主持的新一集《Talk Easy》podcast中，Jason Sudeikis分享了回歸拍攝《Ted Lasso》第四季的經歷，並談及第五季的現況以及製作更多季度的計劃。', 'paragraph_context': 'On a new episode of the podcast Talk Easy with Sam Frogoso, Jason Sudeikis discusses his experience returning to Ted Lasso for season 4, and addresses the current status of season 5 and plan for more seasons.'}

{'text': '第三季完結後，Apple似乎全體演員都希望繼續拍攝《Ted Lasso》。但每次接受訪問時，所有相關人員被問到會否開拍第四季，都將問題交由Sudeikis決定。這位《Ted Lasso》創意總指揮當時仍未決定是否想讓劇集延續。', 'paragraph_context': 'After season 3 concluded, Apple and it seemed the entire cast wanted more Ted Lasso. But repeatedly in interviews, everyone involved deferred to Sudeikis when asked about a potential season 4. The creative leader behind Lasso wasn’t sure if he wanted the show to go on.'}

{'text': '不過，這次情況似乎有所不同。', 'paragraph_context': 'This time around, however, things sound different.'}

{'text': '以下是Sudeikis在podcast節目中談及製作更多季《Ted Lasso》時所說的內容：', 'paragraph_context': 'Here’s what Sudeikis said during his podcast appearance about more Ted Lasso seasons:'}

{'text': 'Sam Frogoso：對你來說，這一切接下來意味着甚麼？你想繼續回到這個世界嗎？你已規劃好第五和第六季了嗎？那是你的計劃嗎？', 'paragraph_context': 'Sam Frogoso: So what does this all mean for you moving forward? You want to keep going back to the well? Do you have season five and six mapped out? Is that the plan?'}

{'text': 'Jason Sudeikis：我的意思是，重新投入其中，正是抱着「哦，我認為裡面還有更多……」這種心態吧……到時再說。這需要大家共同努力。', 'paragraph_context': 'Jason Sudeikis: I mean, that was the endeavor of going back into it, just sort of like, oh, I think there’s more in there…We’ll see. It takes a village.'}

{'text': 'Frogoso：你想製作嗎？', 'paragraph_context': 'Frogoso: Do you want to do it?'}

{'text': 'Sudeikis：我想，是啊。我覺得會很有意思。', 'paragraph_context': 'Sudeikis: I would like to, yeah. I think it would be fun.'}

{'text': 'Frogoso：對於劇集會否再開拍更多季，你一直三緘其口。', 'paragraph_context': 'Frogoso: You’re being mighty coy about whether there’s going to be more seasons of the show.'}

{'text': 'Sudeikis：哦，這是無意中造成的。', 'paragraph_context': 'Sudeikis: Oh, unintentionally.'}

{'text': 'Frogoso：你是單純不知道嗎？', 'paragraph_context': 'Frogoso: Do you just not know?'}

{'text': 'Sudeikis：對，我只是不知道。我們還未成立編劇室之類的團隊。', 'paragraph_context': 'Sudeikis: Yeah, I just don’t know. We haven’t started a writers room or anything like that.'}

{'text': 'Frogoso：但如果按你所言想繼續製作，Apple應該會同意。', 'paragraph_context': 'Frogoso: But Apple would do it if, presumably, you want to keep going.'}

{'text': 'Sudeikis：我推測應該會。', 'paragraph_context': 'Sudeikis: I would assume so.'}

{'text': '從他的言論來看，劇集若再開拍更多季，幕後似乎仍在進行一些商議。', 'paragraph_context': 'Reading between the lines, it sounds like there are some behind-the-scenes negotiations still ongoing regarding additional seasons.'}

{'text': '第四季開播前，相關報道指Sudeikis已為劇集構思好新的三季故事線，這正是Frogoso在第一條問題中所指的內容。雖然Sudeikis聽起來完全支持並準備好按計劃推出更多季，但顯然仍有某件事阻礙劇集進展。', 'paragraph_context': 'Before season 4 began, reporting indicated Sudeikis had a new three-season arc in mind for the show. That’s what Frogoso refers to in his initial question. And while Sudeikis sounds fully onboard and ready to move forward with his plan for more seasons, clearly something is holding up the show.'}

{'text': 'JBK的最高留言', 'paragraph_context': 'Top comment by JBK'}

{'text': '剛過去周末（2026年10月16日至17日），我在YouTube重看《Ted Lasso》早期季數的片段，也閱讀了其他觀眾在Christopher Orr《The New York Times》發表的簡明、切實而深刻的分析下留下的留言。粉絲大多熱愛《Ted Lasso》，但同時也清楚顯示，多數人認為第四季的質素顯著下降。', 'paragraph_context': "I've spent the past weekend (October 16-17, 2026) rewatching snippets of earlier Ted Lasso episodes on YouTube, and reading the comments posted by other viewers on the pithy, informative, insightful analysis by Christopher Orr in The New York Times. It is clear that most fans love Ted Lasso, but it is also clear that most felt there was a significant drop in quality with Season 4."}

{'text': '就我而言，我雖然非常喜歡第一至第三季，但如果第五和第六季也會像第四季一樣，我認為是時候放棄了。這並不是對Lady Greyhounds有任何不滿，只是劇集的劇作和故事質素實在令人大失所望。就讓沉眠的Diamond Dogs安息吧。', 'paragraph_context': "As for me, as much as I love Seasons 1-3, if 5&6 will be like 4, I'd contend it's time to give it up. Nothing against the Lady Greyhounds, it's just the quality of writing and stories left much to be desired. Let sleeping Diamond Dogs lie."}

{'text': '第四季播出期間，《Ted Lasso》一直是Apple TV最多人收看的劇集。雖然成績遠不及第三季的高峰，但對這串流平台而言仍然非常熱門。', 'paragraph_context': 'During its season 4 run, Ted Lasso was consistently the top-viewed show on Apple TV. While it didn’t hit nearly the heights that season 3 enjoyed, it was still very much a hit for the streamer.'}

{'text': '如果你正在尋找另一部Apple TV喜劇，《Small Prophets》被誉为「今年登上Apple平台的最佳劇集」。', 'paragraph_context': 'If you’re looking for another Apple TV comedy to watch, Small Prophets has been hailed as “the finest show to hit Apple this year.”'}

{'text': '你希望《Ted Lasso》再推出更多季嗎？請在留言區告訴我們。', 'paragraph_context': 'Do you want Ted Lasso to come back for more seasons? Let us know in the comments.'}
